L0_EXECUTION_VALIDITY.question: canonical runtime executed to a valid completion (no fault, sufficient horizon, deterministic identity)

L1_MODEL_STATE_VALIDITY.question: every state physically admissible (finite, no fall, no prohibited contact, penetration bounded, joint/actuator limits, no artificial support)

L2_EVENT_SEQUENCE_VALIDITY.question: E1-E12 monotone order with declared physical semantics and dwells

L3_TASK_PERFORMANCE_VALIDITY.question: primary performance floor met and physics consistency checks pass

L4_LANDING_CAPTURE_VALIDITY.question: whole-body admissible landing capture; point-in-time at E10 confirmation + explicit behavioral windows L4-T8 [E10, E11_onset], L4-T9/L4-T10 [first contact, E10]

L5_RECOVERY_VALIDITY.question: balance captured and robust standing envelope achieved; recovery maintenance over [E11_confirmation, E12_confirmation]; FULL_EPISODE QUALIFIED; post-E12 observation margin

L6_CANDIDATE_CREDIBILITY.question: provenance, determinism, test validity, owner visual review

success_composition.TASK_SUCCESS: EXECUTION_VALID AND MODEL_STATE_VALID AND EVENT_CHAIN_VALID AND TASK_PERFORMANCE_VALID AND LANDING_VALID AND BALANCE_VALID AND RECOVERY_VALID AND NO_HARD_FAILURE
non_inference_rules: EVENT_CHAIN_VALID=true never implies any other component
a component with an open owner decision is unresolved/false, never inferred
later-layer success never repairs earlier-layer failure
RECOVERY_VALID is false unless FULL_EPISODE support continuity is QUALIFIED
a support scope whose closing event does not confirm is NOT_EVALUABLE, never silently QUALIFIED
while any owner decision affecting a component is open, that component is unresolved/false and TASK_SUCCESS can never be true
L4-T8 is NOT_EVALUABLE if E11 never onsets, and LANDING_VALID is then false

terminology_freeze.INITIAL_STANDING_COM_Z: COM world z at E1 confirmation reference sample
terminology_freeze.COUNTERMOVEMENT_MIN_COM_Z: minimum COM world z after E1 and before physical takeoff
terminology_freeze.PROPULSION: sustained net-positive upward COM propulsion under bilateral support (E5 window)
terminology_freeze.FORCE_THRESHOLD_TAKEOFF: measurement observable: first bilateral Fz < F_thr sustained 0.010 s; comparability only
terminology_freeze.FIRST_TRANSIENT_FORCE_DROPOUT: first transient bilateral below-F_thr sample regardless of contact (diagnostic)
terminology_freeze.SUSTAINED_FORCE_OFF: first sample of the final uninterrupted sustained below-F_thr bilateral run (diagnostic)
terminology_freeze.PHYSICAL_TAKEOFF: first sample with both contact sets empty, positive clearance both feet, COM vz > 0, no non-plantar support (E6)
terminology_freeze.GENUINE_FLIGHT: sustained physical no-contact + positive clearance both feet for the declared dwell (E7)
terminology_freeze.PHYSICAL_FLIGHT_INTERVAL: [PHYSICAL_TAKEOFF, descending-landing first contact]; contains no foot-floor contact rows
terminology_freeze.APEX: deterministic COM vz positive-to-non-positive crossing strictly inside physical flight (E8); no dwell
terminology_freeze.COM_APEX_Z: COM world z at apex (absolute, never called a height)
terminology_freeze.TAKEOFF_COM_VZ: COM vertical velocity at physical takeoff
terminology_freeze.FLIGHT_TIME_FORCE_DEFINED: force-threshold landing time - force-threshold takeoff time (comparability only)
terminology_freeze.LEFT_FOOT_CLEARANCE: signed minimum distance left foot lowest geometry point to floor; > 0 separated
terminology_freeze.RIGHT_FOOT_CLEARANCE: signed minimum distance right foot lowest geometry point to floor; > 0 separated
terminology_freeze.LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT: first physical floor contact after flight with contact row and foot_clearance <= 0
terminology_freeze.BILATERAL_LANDING: both feet establish plantar contact with load within declared establishment dwell D_BL
terminology_freeze.IMPACT_ABSORPTION: E10: bilateral-support run with residual vertical COM speed below V_ABS_TAIL and admissible L4 whole-body state
terminology_freeze.BALANCE_CAPTURE: E11: sustained whole-body captured state (sagittal COM speed, Hy, support margin, CoP validity, bilateral support)
terminology_freeze.RECOVERY_READY: reported state: captured and in recovery-entry set allowing standing recovery without an extreme corrective maneuver
terminology_freeze.STABLE_STANDING: E12: robust physical standing-envelope membership sustained 0.500 s; RES-87-calibrated envelope
terminology_freeze.PROHIBITED_CONTACT: support by any non-plantar non-fall geom or artificial support
terminology_freeze.REFLIGHT: force-only CANONICAL_REFLIGHT (RES-57): whole Fz < 10.0 N for N_true >= 4 consecutive physics samples (declared SAMPLE_COUNT semantics; span 0.375 ms); historical 0.5 ms wording is an erratum; window-bound after E9 confirmation; chatter separate
terminology_freeze.SUPPORT_CONTINUITY: scoped support-episode quality per SUPPORT_CONTINUITY_SCOPE_ID; QUALIFIED/NOT_QUALIFIED only
terminology_freeze.BW: SYSTEM_WEIGHT = m_system * g = 95.0 kg * 9.81 = 931.95 N; the single normative body-weight quantity (athlete + load)
terminology_freeze.cop_valid: CoP valid under the declared per-foot validity threshold; per-foot validities and resultant CoP reported; frame per RES-84 (PD-05)
terminology_freeze.FLIGHT_TIME_HEIGHT: g * T_flight_physical^2 / 8 with T_flight_physical = LANDING_FIRST_CONTACT_TIME - PHYSICAL_TAKEOFF_TIME; g = 9.81
terminology_freeze.RECOVERY_VALID: E12 envelope/robustness AND FULL_EPISODE QUALIFIED AND post-E12 observation margin (OD-13)
terminology_freeze.TAKEOFF_COM_Z: COM world z at physical takeoff [m]; used by COM_RISE_TAKEOFF_TO_APEX
terminology_freeze.E11_ONSET: ONSET_SAMPLE of the confirmed E11 run; >= E10_confirmation; NOT_EVALUABLE window if E11 never confirms

retired_conflations: apex_height as absolute coordinate called a height
slice support result presented as full-episode qualification
0.0363 m and 0.0752 m sharing one label
regime_handoff_semantics: E12 is a physical-state event; CONTROLLER_HANDOFF_TIME and CONTROLLER_REGIME_AT_E12_ONSET reported separately
